name: DR02
summary:
DR02 is DEEP Robotics' industrial humanoid designed for operation beyond controlled indoor laboratories. Its distinguishing feature is an IP66-rated body, with the manufacturer emphasizing resistance to dust and water exposure in settings such as factories and outdoor work areas.

The published operating-temperature range is -20°C to 55°C, supporting the company's intended use across cold, hot and humid environments. DR02 combines humanoid mobility with industrial environmental protection to support application development where terrain and weather complicate robot operation. Protection rating

DR02 is DEEP Robotics' industrial humanoid designed for operation beyond controlled indoor laboratories. Its distinguishing feature is an IP66-rated body, with the manufacturer emphasizing resistance to dust and water exposure in settings such as factories and outdoor work areas.

The published operating-temperature range is -20°C to 55°C, supporting the company's intended use across cold, hot and humid environments. DR02 combines humanoid mobility with industrial environmental protection to support application development where terrain and weather complicate robot operation. Protection ratings and temperature limits describe the hardware envelope; a particular inspection or manipulation task still requires appropriate software, equipment and deployment validation.
